answer: Decay-Weighted Storage Rent Every agent identity must continuously deposit funds into an escrow to maintain state data in the system registry, styled as an oasis for active computation. The required deposit scales exponentially with the aggregate transaction volume processed by closely linked peer addresses, pushing the marginal expense toward a financial nadir only for isolated, single-actor workflows. An attacker spawning millions of sybils faces compounding upkeep costs that strip capital faster than a neglected garden, making large-scale fabrication economically unsustainable.
